items.headline: KPMG Women’s PGA Purse Boost
items.text: The KPMG Women’s PGA Championship increased its purse to $13 million, the largest in women's golf history, and plans to add artificial intelligence features.

items.headline: Tiger Woods Returns to PGA Tour
items.text: Tiger Woods made a quiet return to PGA Tour business by attending a Policy Board vote on CEO Brian Rolapp’s proposed schedule overhaul after rehab for a March DUI arrest.
